items.name: Pirate's Treasure Menu
items.description: Starter, main course and dessert (drink not included). Starters: smoked chicken chiquetaille with green papaya, Caribbean fish soup, black-eyed peas salad or spiced black pudding and smoked sausage; mains: roasted mahi-mahi fillet, chicken and prawn Colombo, vegetable Colombo curry or grilled jerk pork; desserts: Caribbean rice pudding, tropical fruit soup or rum and pineapple shortbread

items.name: Moussaillon Menu
items.description: For children ages 3 to 11. Starter, main course, dessert and drink. Drink: Vittel 33 cl, orange or apple juice 25 cl or glass of milk 20 cl; starters: potted tuna and whole wheat tortilla chips, chickpea, sweetcorn, cucumber and tomato salad or quinoa and tomato salad; mains: coconut-crusted chicken fillet or mahi-mahi fillet with coconut and passion fruit sauce (side: rice, sweet potato mash or mixed green vegetables), or pasta with a tomato and vegetable sauce; desserts: coconut and vanilla rice pudding with salted caramel sauce, fruit smoothie, fruit salad or Mousse ahoy! chocolate dessert
